text: I felt clangs as we walked, we talked for hours, it could've been days. For I was mesmerized by everything she had to say. Her gaze was firmly fixed and I felt warmth through those big green eyes. No lies could pass between us, we were pure in our togetherness. Our emotions were running free and I could sense the connection between us. Round me around and I think I could begin to comprehend. But then, I felt attention build up inside me as I thought of it.
